description: This PHP file defines the CalendarAccountViewEdit class, which extends ViewEdit. It handles pre-display logic for editing calendar account records within SuiteCRM, including initializing calendar source types, setting user IDs, and managing user permissions related to personal calendar accounts.

classes.name: CalendarAccountViewEdit
classes.description: A class that manages the editing view for Calendar Account records in SuiteCRM, including setup and permission checks before display.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the edit view by initializing calendar source types, setting user identifiers, checking permissions, and injecting JavaScript to indicate admin status.
